title: Kestrel and the Parish
author: Freya Zhou
blurb: Rafael Coldharbour, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
